_about: Topics tools/refresh_osirdraft.mjs drafts OSIR analyst sections for once a day (.github/workflows/osir-draft.yml). Each: cc (country), scope (a data set or conflict tab id as the OSIR window's Topic list uses it; empty = all reporting), days (the period, ending today), name. Keep the list short: drafts share GitHub Models' free daily limit with the event summaries. Any other topic can be drafted on demand from the workflow's Run button.
